mapper.select: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY position ASC, name ASC
SELECT * FROM categories WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY position ASC, name ASC
SELECT * FROM categories WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY position ASC, name ASC
SELECT * FROM categories WHERE slug = #{slug} AND is_active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (id, parent_id, name, slug, description, image_url, position, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{parentId}, #{name}, #{slug}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{position}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE categories SET parent_id = #{parentId}, name = #{name}, slug = #{slug}, description = #{description}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, position = #{position}, is_active = #{isActive}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
